articles.title: Esther Hobart, 69, Hardware Store Owner
articles.deck: Friends remember Esther Hobart for the many years of service to Bellwood.
body: Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Upper Commons Historical Society in his or her name. Born in Bellwood in the years after the war, Esther Hobart spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Esther Hobart died in November at home on Maple Terrace, at the age of 69. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Bellwood.
